correctness.rationale: The exact marked mass follows by distinct-prefix enumeration. For \(p_i>p_j\) the cross-product between consecutive time row-ratios equals \((p_i-p_j)(E_k^2-E_{k-1}E_{k+1})\), strictly positive by Newton inequalities including \(m=2\) and both endpoints. This proves all minors, conditional strict likelihood-ratio and stochastic orders, positive row comparison, and the iff-uniform independence condition. The exact rational checker independently verifies examples and all claimed finite boundaries; it is not used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Novelty assessed for the strict reverse likelihood-ratio order of the joint marked time/type law, not for the old unmarked birthday count. The Camarri–Pitman observed-set formulas and Flajolet–Gardy–Thimonier symmetric-polynomial expectations do not themselves state the conditional all-pairs minor signs, stochastic order, or independence characterization. A complete proof is supplied by a separate Newton inequality argument. Related literature searches and published mathematical-record comparisons yielded no covering result, subject to the stated inaccessible-source risk.
residual_risks: The full text of Holst (1995) was inaccessible; the abstract alone is insufficient to rule out an unstated marked-result implication.
An earlier general TP2/likelihood-ratio lemma for marked first-collision times may imply the result without sharing its title or terminology; search absence is not an independent proof of novelty.

The identity for the unmarked first-repeat mass, and the underlying elementary symmetric coefficients, are classical; originality is claimed only for the strict all-pairs marked ordering and consequences.

value.rationale: When a collision is observed in a heterogeneous categorical population, knowing which category repeated changes the distribution of detection delay. The strict likelihood-ratio theorem controls every increasing elapsed-time loss and rules out independence except under equal weights. This is a natural, motivated structural property of marked birthday collisions, not an arbitrary finite-parameter slice or a mere known-table evaluation.
